Name: Stardew and Chill - Music Replacer
Author: VibrantLGBT
Description:
[center][size=6]Stardew & Chill
[/size][/center]
[line]
[size=5]What does it do?
[/size]
[size=4]It replaces many of the music tracks in the game with tracks from the album [i]Stardew & Chill[/i] by Dj Cutman and Coffee Date.

As of version 2.0, it also includes tracks from [i]Stardew & Chill 2[/i] by Coffee Date.[center]
[youtube]yEPUhesWICA[/youtube][youtube]aWkD4jp-bYg[/youtube][/center][/size]

[size=4][b][i]This mod was developed with full and informed permission from the artists/publisher.[/i][/b]

With regard to streaming the game while using the mod: I specifically asked, and it was specifically indicated to me that streaming the game while using the mod [i][b]is allowed[/b][/i]. (Most of [i]GameChops [/i]music is allowed for usage while streaming via specific licenses, with credit - so please consider giving them a link/shout out if you use the mod while streaming, and check out their video descriptions or website for specific license details.)

As soon as I heard the music, I fell in love with it immediately and set about trying to make this happen.  Huge thanks to everyone involved for allowing this mod to exist.  If you like the music, please show these folks some love, I'm only the delivery person on this one. You can learn more about the music and the artists here, and I personally recommend checking them out: [url=https://gamechops.com/stardew-and-chill/]
https://gamechops.com/stardew-and-chill/[/url][/size]
[size=4][url=https://gamechops.com/stardew-chill-2/]https://gamechops.com/stardew-chill-2/[/url][/size][size=3]

[size=4]Stardew & Chill is produced by Coffee Date and Dj Cutman, and published by GameChops.
Stardew & Chill 2 is produced by Coffee Date, and published by GameChops.
Composed by ConcernedApe.

[i][b]This is not a sponsored or affiliated mod, I genuinely loved the music and reached out to them to see if I could put it in the game.[/b][/i][/size][/size]
[size=5]  [/size]
[size=5][size=5]How do I install it?[/size]
[size=4]There are no dependencies other than SMAPI. Just extract the zip into your mods folder and enjoy. [/size][/size]


[size=5]Does this work in multiplayer?[/size]
[size=4]Yes. (Multiplayer is entirely irrelevant to this mod.)[/size]
